title: Full localization parity as deployment blocker
context: 'memory-you-never-babysit' (v1.9.4) remained the only blog post untranslated to all four supported locales (he/ru/ar/es), fragmenting user experience by language.
decision: Establish localization completeness as a release gate. New v1.11 post launches with translations to all four locales from start; backfilled missing translations for v1.9.4 to close the gap.
consequences: Blog post deployment blocked until all four locale translations complete
Guarantees consistent post catalog across all language audiences
Eliminates experience gaps where some users see English-only posts
alternatives_rejected: Ship English first, translate asynchronously (creates temporary gaps for non-English users)
Skip translation for lower-traffic locales (inconsistent user experience)
Auto-translate via tooling (quality risk for technical/product content)
